categories.main_business_segments: Daelim Trading Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the manufacturing and sales of building materials including water faucets, bidets, sensors, shower booths, and other construction materials. It also produces stainless steel tableware and kitchenware through subsidiaries. The company serves both domestic and export markets with a focus on mid-to-high-end products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced assembly and metal processing technologies, especially in brass-based sanitary fittings and stainless steel tableware production. It emphasizes eco-friendly and energy-saving product development, such as the Eco Cartridge for water-saving faucets. Production facilities include specialized plants for faucets and bidets with standardized processes and high utilization rates.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include construction companies, distributors, and OEM partners such as Hanil Sangsa, Jinwoon Housing, Fortessa, and Riobel. The company targets the domestic Korean market and international markets including the Americas and Asia, focusing on mid-to-high-end building materials and lifestyle products.
categories.geographic_coverage: Daelim Trading operates mainly in South Korea with significant export activities to the Americas and Asian regions. Subsidiaries in Indonesia also contribute to production and sales. The company maintains a presence in major global markets through OEM partnerships and direct exports.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing finished building materials and lifestyle products. It sources raw materials like brass ingots and stainless steel, processes them into finished goods, and sells directly to construction firms, distributors, and OEM clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous product quality improvement, functional enhancement, and innovative design development. R&D efforts focus on eco-friendly, energy-saving technologies and new product development in sanitary fittings and bidets. The company invests in design excellence, winning multiple international design awards, and collaborates with global partners for product innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of building materials, sanitary fittings, bidets, tableware, and kitchenware. Sales channels include direct sales to construction companies, distributors, OEM contracts, and retail platforms. The company also earns income from leasing and other ancillary services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Daelim Trading is positioned as a leading comprehensive building materials specialist in Korea with strong brand recognition and design awards. It competes with other domestic and international manufacturers of sanitary fittings and building materials, leveraging quality, design, and eco-friendly product features to differentiate itself.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 145.7 billion KRW in 2023, down 16.3% from the previous year, with total assets of about 177.1 billion KRW. It has experienced fluctuations in profitability with a net loss in 2023 but maintains a solid asset base and ongoing investments in R&D. The company has a moderate debt ratio and continues to focus on operational improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Daelim Trading emphasizes superior product quality, innovative design, and eco-friendly features such as energy-saving cartridges. It has been recognized repeatedly for quality competitiveness and international design awards, offering customers reliable, functional, and aesthetically advanced building materials and lifestyle products. The company also provides strong after-sales service, particularly for bidet products.
